subject: Add a repository-wording gate that fails on internal requirement labels in Loom's explanatory text
description:
RESULT (2026-10-03, AMC-D-PF3XTNPM), Loom commit 61b5b0a (push failed: GHES "Maximum (20) redirects followed", ignored per decision 8). Done by the orchestrator inline: a small single-area change.

DESIGN:
- The patterns have one home in core: packages/core/src/wording.ts#prohibitedMarkers. It finds labels (an upper-case prefix of two or more characters, a hyphen and a number, minus a standards and licence prefix allowlist), iteration labels (phase/iteration/milestone/sprint/wave/increment/gate/release/round N, vN, except when followed by ".<digit>") and generation terms (legacy, backward(s) compat*, "new in <version>", "<adjective> generation"). It also removes technology tokens with a version suffix of their own (stateDiagram-v2).
- Single-letter labels (D-3) are not matched, because the shape equals domain identifiers such as account A-1, which the spec's legitimate-content statement protects.
- "no longer" was left out: a measured scan of all tracked files found 3 uses, all describing runtime or domain state.
- The scan before any change found no marker in the tree (2026-10-03).
- The rule applies only to Loom's own repository: `docs --check --self` (root = loomRoot) and the CLI self-test. Plain `docs --check` for an adopter is unchanged, because an adopter's "legacy system" is legitimate.
- With --self, the link and history checks cover every markdown file and every comment under the root.
- New finding: DOCUMENT_PROHIBITED_MARKER (error) in FindingCode, FINDING_RULES and RAISED_ELSEWHERE ('CLI documentation check').
- Contract digest changed to sha256:58da5ae7… (before task 9's baseline, so no change record is needed).

VERIFIED:
- npm run build: generate --check 6 artifacts current, 56 fixture cases passed.
- Core battery: "loom self-test PASS: 24 sections, 2318 assertions", including the new section "generated wording". A planted "phase 2." at first escaped the iteration lookahead; the guard fired, and the pattern was fixed.
- node --test --test-name-pattern "docs" cli.test.js: tests 4, pass 4, fail 0.
- `docs --check --self`: findings 0.
- coverage --check with this run's TAP: 124 capabilities, 232 cases, no CODE/CONTRACT/CASE_UNKNOWN finding; docs.release-wording has 0 findings. The remaining CASE_FAILED come from suites not supplied, which task 28 provides.
- The CLI self-test stage (selftest.ts#runSelfTest) is exercised in task 28's full run.

DOCS: README CLI table (docs --check --self row, --self-test row), the cli.ts usage, Tools/loom/CLAUDE.md:18 (self-test stages), and the capability docs.release-wording.
Crosswalk evidence recorded on #14, #15, #18, #19 and #423 (shared statements accumulate evidence).
